correctness.rationale: With zero or one mark, an extension type specifies only a color, since no distinct ordered triple is yet present. With at least two marks, it specifies an oriented gap and a color (already at two marks, C distinguishes the two gaps). For rank at least s+1, each challenged gap must offer a pivot of each color with two child gaps of linear rank at least s; other gaps keep their ranks. Induction thus gives the minimum-of-gaps formula, then the two small-mark formulas. Challenging a fixed color recursively in a linear gap of rank s forces 2^s−1 occurrences; challenging the same color for each of the first two circular points forces 2^(t−1) including those points. In a cycle of 2^(t−1) permutations, the second point chosen in the period starting q·2^(t−2) positions beyond the first leaves at least q(2^(t−2)−1) positions in each open arc; induction by a central period gives each arc the requisite rank. Adding points preserves the induced witnesses, including when nq⁻¹ is not an exact power of two. Rank two reduces to each color appearing twice. An independent game keyed by actual ternary-relation values confirmed that of all 70 balanced eight-position words exactly the eight rotations of 00001111 fail rank three; the other orbit sizes are 2,4,8,8,8,8,8,8,8. A same-color second challenge on the excluded word always leaves an arc without both colors. The finite census confirms the explicit certificate; the universal law uses the proof, not numerical extrapolation.
residual_risks: Named, exhaustive colors and the strict oriented ternary language are essential. No census for larger parameters or arbitrary cyclic signatures is certified.
